body:
Consolidates nine Symmetry node bindings and the shared canvas/display launcher alias into the existing `els` table. Module `let` declarations fall from **275 to 265**, with the same queries, priming, listeners, null guards and function bodies after lexical reference substitution. The production bytes are identical to frozen #20 (`537e95f`); this candidate also carries the original failed CI and the paired diagnostic evidence.

The conversion remains **+86/−86** app lines, 33,069 lines and 1,181 top-level function declarations. Independent source audit covered all 1,190 existing function declarations and the entire app after 81 references in ten functions. The alias uses one canonical plain `els.displayWindowAdaptiveMenuEl` at its original query site; it adds no second accessor/query. No controller or new dependency interface is introduced: ten binding inventory items plus the existing helper is eleven inventory items, not extraction inputs. The periodic-table factory remains at **19 inputs**.

### Manual verification

Affected unchanged suites: `symmetry_panel.py`, `workbench_bar.py`, `workbench_consistency.py`, and `floating_panels.py`, each passed once on tagged and proposed sources. Native comparisons covered tolerances, candidates, preview/cancel/apply/Undo/Auto, element guides, keyboard/shared launcher/exclusivity, responsive 390px, scene changes, dock/float/minimize/layout/Focus in both themes and layouts. Their original raw collector diagnostics remain preserved.

Completed local verification was preserved without rerunning it: checks, 433 JavaScript and 29 Python tests; four unchanged UI suites on both sources; both-theme Workbench/legacy native comparisons; and 102 unchanged captures twice with exact repeat, zero diagnostic pixel changes, all 52 slots in eight contexts and every current reason minimum. Workbench composition is 47 live + 5 known absent; legacy is 48 + 4.

The original [#20 CI attempt](https://github.com/evangelistalab/vibemol/actions/runs/38994402382) remains **failed at 33/4/37**, with the unexpected `edit_tool.py` 320px overflow assertion. Its characterization, identities, checks and WebKit passed; Looks completed both material paths in 1,905.27 s without the material-preset timeout. Full CI took 32.95 minutes. That failed run is retained and is not merge evidence.

A separately authorized, harness-only [instrumented diagnostic](https://github.com/evangelistalab/vibemol/actions/runs/39034319620) checked both immutable trees in the original Linux Chromium 156 / Playwright 1.64 runtime:

| At the unchanged 320px assertion | Integration `e35da9c` | Symmetry `537e95f` |
|---|---:|---:|
| scrollWidth / clientWidth | 442 / 12 | 442 / 12 |
| milliseconds since last `fitTools()` entry | 244.2 | 230.8 |
| trigger present / hidden / aria-expanded | yes / yes / false | yes / yes / false |
| menu rows / hidden | 0 / yes | 0 / yes |

Both assertions failed. The original integration-equivalent full CI had previously passed this suite in 82.10 s. The diagnostic establishes the same measured overflow on integration as on Symmetry; it does not establish a precise production cause or tagged-CI reproduction. The identical DevTools probe can affect timing, never pauses, and is absent from this candidate's ordinary CI. The finding is filed and carried as [issue #21](https://github.com/evangelistalab/vibemol/issues/21) under the direct human both-overflow decision.

**Own first-pass merge conjunction independently verified:** [CI 39034824420, attempt 1](https://github.com/evangelistalab/vibemol/actions/runs/39034824420), frozen head `dea1a9b745d7c6ca4c69f579927f5365d70a1a74`, base `e35da9c`, tested checkout `92842ae1777dc1abad798dc09388c30844b6e07e`, exact tree `f7e99c3fb3740d93aa5d9d8e1cb6658764f760de`. All eleven jobs passed. Both shipped joins were independently re-executed with validated artifact identity; all nine original artifact ZIP digests matched GitHub. All 37 suites ran once: **34 passed / 3 specified failures**, verified from raw Escape, Coordinates Delete and #11 vibration-after-second-download workflows. Vibration was reached. `edit_tool.py` passed in **85.45 s**; its uninstrumented log has no numeric widths. Issue #21 remains carried and is not an accepted fourth failure. Both 102 unchanged-golden runs matched and repeated exactly, with zero diagnostic pixel changes. All 52 slots in eight contexts retained Workbench 47+5 / legacy 48+4 composition and met every current firing minimum. Actual presented checks: 39/32; mode checks 408/9 (404/6 observed beyond explicit checks); panel transitions 766–1199, DOM checks 2987–5465, restore 1 per context. Checks/unit **433 JS / 29 Python** and WebKit passed. Baseline recording remained normally skipped.

Looks completed both Studio and Properties material-families paths in **1,299.27 s / 21.65 min** with no timeout. `#appearanceMaterialPreset` did not recur; its risk remains open. Actual renderer: Linux x86_64, Chromium **156.0.8078.4**, Playwright **1.64.0**, ANGLE Vulkan SwiftShader (Subzero). Full sharded CI was **1,919 s / 31.9833 min** from creation through final join, against **132.93 min**: **75.94% less / 4.156×**, eight cold-cache misses. Critical worker: balanced-1 (1,904 s job / 1,858.08 s batch). The diagnostic never supplies merge evidence; the complete ordinary conjunction above does.

Only `app.js` changes in production. No workflow, shipped test, assertion, wait, fixture, golden, QA bridge or periodic-table module changes. The new diagnostic workflow/harness is retained as evidence under `tests/baselines/evidence/stage3/symmetry/instrumented-edit-tool-ci-39034319620/harness/`, not installed as an active workflow. Existing #3, #11, Escape/Coordinates Delete, #17 and #5/#14/#15 follow-ups remain carried; the material-preset intermittent stays open. Element Colors and the single stage-boundary soak follow only after this candidate passes and merges.
